front_three_quarter.finding: Curved panes follow the common canopy; tapered hood and rounded fascia replace overlapping blockout surfaces.

rear_three_quarter.finding: Rear glass lands on the matched deck; boot and rear quarter skins remain separate.

side.finding: Continuous crown, rearward cowl/crown correction, four doors, fixed quarter glazing, and unchanged axle centers.

front.finding: Symmetric curved windshield, closed EV face, three-blade lights and lower dimples. Aero return closes the fascia/splitter gap.

rear.finding: Symmetric rear canopy and fascia; original lamp strips follow the new surface.

top.finding: Tapered bonnet, body waist, and independently editable panoramic roof, windshield, rear glazing, and deck.

limitations: Concept illustrations do not establish exact orthographic constraints or approved dimensions.
Wheel and cabin geometry remain inherited placeholders; detailing is not at concept-render fidelity.
Light, badge, and aero detail are not a certified finished v1; legacy open edges are reported separately.
Static ray probes do not replace in-game first-person, seating, or door-function tests.
